description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Notify the Special Commodity Levy on Potatoes & B' onions
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory measures, specifies levy rates for commodities, and rescinds previous orders. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
